## What code will check of you (continued from handoff-keys-2.md)

### Only in a window (replaced by "Only in a plan dispatch") (continued)

- [s5_precheck:sides.provisional] Every live `provisional[]` row of this window has a `kind` from `references/provisional-kinds.json`, a `settles_on` that is a side of this story, a `home.file` whose placeholder line carries the comment `qa-provisional: <id>`, and `dependents` as a list of `{case, then}` that are bound in `then_bindings`; every `qa-provisional: <id>` marker in a test file of the window has its `provisional[]` row. Door: send the row or the field through `manifest_put.py --fragment`, or take the marker out of the test file.
- [s5_precheck:sides.settled] A provisional row whose side is now real is not left open (unless it is a first-look accounting row): it is settled in the bind round, retracted, or kept by decision citing the person's word `substitute kept: <side>`; a settled row (`settled_matched` / `settled_edited`) cites in `evidence.run` a run block that is not a collect and whose stamp says its side was real, keeps the comment `qa-provisional: <id>` on its home line, and its status agrees with that line: `settled_matched` when the line is unchanged since `home_hash`, `settled_edited` when it changed and stands as the tool recorded in `evidence.home_hash_after`. Door: run the test on the real side, then send the row with `status` and `evidence: {run: <block id>}` through `manifest_put.py --fragment` (the tool records the hashes itself); or retract it.

### Not yet in rows

s5_precheck.py will check, so write to it: every Then is bound in `then_bindings[]` {case, then, instance_id, assertion_ref "file:line"}, and the names it demands appear in that assertion. A status code or literal a Then fixes is asserted as written and NEVER changed after a red run: that test is handed over RED, `unresolved[] reason: contradicts_requirement`. A value you invented may change after a red run only with an `expectation_changes[]` row through manifest_put.py: `then_refs` [{case, then}] it still proves, `what_changed`, `reason`; a deleted or renamed test owes it too. A `blocked_by_env` row has `remedy` {kind, where, change, restart}, names only; it stands only on a run showing the stand (`env_blocked`, a STAND SIGNAL on a run no timeout killed, a connection refusal); a test the project's timeout killed is yours. Smells refused: env credentials in an assert, `None == None`, `sleep`, a copied helper. One `tests[]` entry per INSTANCE (`func[param]`); `covers` lists cases. A `deferred_by_decision:*` row carries `disputes` nothing|derivation|case_expectation; `derivation` = not derivable; `case_expectation` = you disagree with the approved case; no route out after gate A.
